description: Per-app rollup in USD cents (latest_payments/refunded/MRR + paid customer count), largest refund-adjusted latest payments first. latest_payments sums the most recent payment per customer, so it is a run-rate and NOT lifetime turnover. No lifetime figure is available per app (accrual is recorded per owner). Use to compare products at a glance; use revenue_summary for one app in depth.
name: revenue_by_app
